issues.description: The problem statement and UML require Farm.animals to be a List/ArrayList<Animal> (and instruct initializing an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor), but the solution implementation declares the field as Queue<Animal> and initializes it with a LinkedList. This type mismatch (List vs Queue/LinkedList) can confuse students about the expected collection type and will break code or tests that expect a List/ArrayList API or signature for the getter/setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm.animals field use List<Animal> (and initialize it as a new ArrayList<>()) and update the getter/setter signatures to use List<Animal>, so the implementation matches the UML/problem statement. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to specify Queue/LinkedList if that change is intentional.
